body: Correction before routing the TASK-1547 brief: it currently lacks the required explicit seat declaration, and its generated setup names a different worktree/branch than the live lease. Please amend the brief preamble to begin `YOUR SEAT: IMPLEMENTER (Codex).` Keep lease 01a0e491 and worktree `/home/joe/ai/aida-task1547`; do not tell it to create/start a second session. It must acknowledge the existing lease/worktree and apply only the rework finding. This explicit seat declaration is a handoff requirement from the operator.
